statement: The recorded “unpaid, due” status is not safe or correct to rely on because the payment history says the invoice was already paid in full, so I will hold it to prevent a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states the "unpaid, due" status "is not safe or correct to rely on" because the record shows it was "already paid in full," identifying the duplicate-payment contradiction.
